title: LIHEAP reaches millions while reported restoration remains a distinct endpoint

observations.period: FY2024; households or families receiving LIHEAP assistance

denominator.unit: HHS annual-report aggregate; source reports a rounded reach count rather than a disclosed survey denominator

liheap_reach.unit: individuals and families reported helped by LIHEAP

vulnerable_household_share.unit: percent of households served including a senior, young child, or person with a disability

observations.method: Official HHS/ACF annual-report spotlight and fact-sheet summary; retain reported program counts without constructing a population rate.
observations.uncertainty: The annual-report counts are program aggregates with rounded language and do not identify the same household over time, benefit amount, timing, or the counterfactual service status.
observations.subgroup: LIHEAP-assisted individuals, families, and heating-assistance households in FY2024.
observations.counterinterpretation: Large reach can reflect substantial need and program capacity at the same time; it does not show that assistance removed the underlying bill or equipment constraint.

observations.period: FY2024; reported restoration of home energy service

denominator.unit: HHS annual-report aggregate; no household-level restoration denominator disclosed

restored_home_energy_instances.unit: reported instances of restored home energy

observations.method: Official HHS/ACF FY2024 annual-report performance summary; restoration is retained as a program-reported endpoint separate from reach and prevention.
observations.uncertainty: An instance of restoration does not establish duration, reconnection cost, next-bill affordability, safe temperature, food or medicine protection, work continuity, or repeat crisis.
observations.subgroup: Reported LIHEAP home-energy restoration instances in FY2024.
observations.counterinterpretation: Restoration may interrupt an immediate loss while leaving an inefficient home, arrears, equipment failure, or payment-timing problem unchanged; a restoration count is not a durable-stability rate.

related_sources.claim: LIHEAP includes heating, cooling, crisis, and weatherization assistance and is intended to reduce health and safety risks.
HHS performance measures separate energy burden, prevention of service loss, and restoration of home energy service.

boundary: This record establishes official program reach and reported restoration as separate public-system endpoints. It does not estimate LIHEAP take-up, household prevalence, benefit adequacy, restoration duration, repeat crisis, protected or sacrificed outcomes, trust, political action, or durable energy security.
